capabilities: Draw Modelica schematics by dragging library components and wiring pins
Simulate and plot models through the locally installed OpenModelica compiler (omc)
Sweep parameters and measure differences between runs
Embed live diagrams, plots, and equation-solving blocks in notes
Edit models as Modelica source with completion and diagnostics
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; desktop only (mobile unsupported); tested only on Linux against OpenModelica 1.27.0 and MSL 4.1.0; works fully offline unless AI assistance is enabled; releases carry signed build-provenance attestations; no telemetry or update checks.
problem: Obsidian has no way to draw, simulate, or plot physical models, so engineers must work in a separate Modelica tool and cannot keep models and derivations alongside their notes.

relations.evidence: It writes a model out as Modelica source, hands that text to the omc you already have installed
so a file round-trips through OMEdit and the other Modelica tools
BRAT installs a plugin straight from its GitHub releases and updates it for you

requires.name: AI provider key (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Groq, OpenRouter, or local server)

summary: Modelica modeling studio with a drag-and-drop schematic editor that simulates and plots systems using a locally installed OpenModelica compiler.
